rules.note: Wideband emitter pushes busy-energy-without-preamble high and makes every scanned channel equally bad (low inter-channel spread) — direct emitter evidence, not a symptom-only call.
Selective emitter raises noise/energy on only some channels, so a scan shows a few very hot channels among clean ones (high inter-channel spread) unlike barrage's uniform hit.
Deep multipath/distance fades cause outages (high silent loss, high shadow-loss) with PDR still tracking RSSI reasonably; critically there is no raised noise floor, no non-preamble energy, and no hot
A dropped/dead node stops answering heartbeats entirely on one link (long heartbeat gap plus strong link asymmetry) while the spectrum itself is clean, ruling out an RF cause.
